prefix_reserve_guard.note: a branch that inherits the whole prefix budget cap holds reserve >= host_feedback_correction_reserve requests, which is what its own correction window can spend after the fork: one edit plus one host verdict is reachable without a fresh allowance

prefix_extension_stopped: the frozen trigger prediction fired after this host round and the branches' pre-registered request reserve is intact; the rest of the shared ceiling is left to the branches

prefix_reserve_at_end.note: a branch that inherits the whole prefix budget cap holds reserve >= host_feedback_correction_reserve requests, which is what its own correction window can spend after the fork: one edit plus one host verdict is reachable without a fresh allowance

trigger_prediction.method: View.from_events(prefix events + the frozen correction user message), then the real configured condenser is run on that view with a throwaway LLM used only for token counting; no provider request is issued

trigger_prediction_measured_on: the frozen end state of this attempt; the prediction was measured on correction round 1, which is also the attempt's last host round because the reserve was satisfied there
